title: Memory wall

summary.definition: memory wall은 계산 유닛보다 데이터를 가져오고 옮기는 속도가 시스템 성능을 제한하는 현상이다.
summary.mechanism: 계산량이 늘어도 대역폭·지연·cache 재사용·통신 비용이 실제 처리량을 제한한다.
summary.example: 연산 유닛이 놀고 있는 동안 HBM에서 데이터를 기다리면 peak FLOPS를 사용할 수 없다.
summary.counterScenario: 메모리 병목 여부는 workload와 데이터 재사용에 따라 달라진다.

article.intuition: memory wall은 계산 유닛보다 데이터를 가져오고 옮기는 속도가 시스템 성능을 제한하는 현상이다.

inputs: 연산 유닛이 놀고 있는 동안 HBM에서 데이터를 기다리면 peak FLOPS를 사용할 수 없다.

article.tradingApplication: 계산기를 더 추가하기 전에 데이터 이동 경로를 측정해야 하는 이유는 무엇인가?
article.invalidation: 메모리 병목 여부는 workload와 데이터 재사용에 따라 달라진다.

researchEvidence.statement: Research on deep networks treats memorization and generalization as distinguishable behaviors that can coexist; fitting training examples alone is not evidence that a model will perform reliably on unseen data.
researchEvidence.scope: Model generalization, memorization, and evaluation boundary
researchEvidence.invalidation: The cited study is empirical and task-specific; it does not provide a universal test for all architectures, datasets, or deployment settings.

researchEvidence.statement: NVIDIA's CUDA guide models heterogeneous systems with CPU host code and GPU device code, describes GPUs as highly parallel processors, and exposes matrix, tile, tensor-core, and multi-level memory operations as separate performance mechanisms.
researchEvidence.scope: CPU/GPU division of work, parallel matrix computation, precision, and memory hierarchy
researchEvidence.invalidation: CUDA is an NVIDIA programming and hardware model; it is not a universal description of every GPU, ASIC, NPU, workload, or measured performance result.

researchEvidence.statement: Google Cloud documents TPUs as application-specific integrated circuits designed for machine-learning workloads, with matrix-multiply units, vector/scalar units, reduced-precision arithmetic, and on-chip high-bandwidth memory.
researchEvidence.scope: Domain-specific AI accelerators and matrix-oriented hardware
researchEvidence.invalidation: A TPU architecture is one accelerator design; its features cannot be generalized to all ASICs, NPUs, models, or production cost/performance without workload-specific evidence.

researchEvidence.statement: TSMC describes 3DFabric as a family of 3D silicon stacking and advanced-packaging technologies that integrates logic, memory, and other chiplets at the system level; packaging therefore affects bandwidth, latency, power, form factor, and cost rather than being only a final enclosure step.
researchEvidence.scope: Advanced packaging, heterogeneous integration, chiplets, and system bottlenecks
researchEvidence.invalidation: This is a vendor technology description; customer yield, capacity, pricing, supply availability, and product economics require independent filing and production evidence.
